title: Hill Conjecture for Complete Graph Crossing Numbers
exact_target: Is the crossing number of every drawing of $K_n$ at least $\frac14\lfloor n/2\rfloor\lfloor(n-1)/2\rfloor\lfloor(n-2)/2\rfloor\lfloor(n-3)/2\rfloor$?
